traceability.notes: All functional requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified. The plugin exports recommended and strict flat-config presets via src/index.ts, and these presets are tested end-to-end using FlatESLint to ensure they integrate cleanly with existing ESLint v9 flat configurations when spread after a plugins registration object (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION). Rule options for key rules (e.g., valid-story-reference, require-story-annotation, valid-annotation-format) are defined with explicit JSON Schemas and `additionalProperties: false`, and tests confirm these schemas expose the expected properties and reject unknown options (REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION). Path and location customization for story files is supported via valid-story-reference and related configuration patterns (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS). User documentation (README, ESLint 9 Setup Guide, API Reference, Examples, Migration Guide) provides clear setup instructions, multiple project-type patterns, and troubleshooting guidance, satisfying the User Experience and Documentation criteria. Error handling for invalid configuration options is provided both through ESLint’s schema validation and through rule-level diagnostics (notably in valid-annotation-format), meeting the Error Handling criterion despite the checkbox in the story file not being updated. Given the passing targeted tests and comprehensive documentation, this story is fully implemented.
